name: Picasso (main) car park: long east wall, outline, central bay row and round island

wall.name: Long white wall between the car park and Calle Pintor Picasso
wall.trust: Estimated. Line read from the Esri World Imagery zoom 19 aerial (the wall's bright top and shadow, straight over its whole length; an independent reviewer found it within about 0.3 m of this line). Plain, rendered, no openings in IMG_3125 and IMG_3129; south end at the white utility building in IMG_3124. Height from the laser survey: a level top at 2.57 m (topBasis). No camera is solved (data/photo_poses.json notes), so the line is not a measured placement.
wall.topBasis: Level top. PNOA-LiDAR 2014-15 2 m surface model (MDS) along the wall line: where the grid catches the wall its top reads 7.53-7.63 m (median 7.57) at 6, 30, 54, 60, 72, 78 and 96 m from the north end, while the ground (2020-21 1 m MDT) falls from 6.09 to 4.51 m; the ground on both sides agrees to 0.1-0.2 m, so it is a free-standing wall, not a retaining wall. Model zero is the middle pool deck, 5.00 m in the 2014-15 survey, so the top is 2.57 m in model metres above the visible paving level. The wall is about 1.4 m high at the uphill north end and about 3.1 m at the south end (Dave, 25 Nov 2026: it should get lower up the slope; IMG_3125 near the south end agrees with about 3 m).

centreRow.trust: Estimated. Midline of the central nose-to-nose bays read from car positions on the aerial (±1.5 m), parallel to the wall, ending short of the round island.

island.trust: Estimated. Edges from brightness profiles on the aerial (west -61.3, east -50.3, south edge z 15.7; independent review 24 Nov 2026), ±0.5 m. IMG_3100 shows a white kerb about a hand high under a clipped hedge; kerb height is a guess. The bed inside is level with the kerb top under the hedge.

outline.trust: East edge pulled onto the wall's inner face (data/street_layout.json mainParkingRing). The west and south edges are unchanged.

barriers.name: Entry barrier, west lane of the car park's north entrance (boom, rest post and bollard)
barriers.trust: Estimated. The west lane, between the gatehouse island and the narrow planter, is the entry: IMG_3131 shows the lane arrow pointing into the car park and Street View from Calle Loira (Oct 2024, Imagery © Google) shows the boom closed across it from a white drive cabinet on the island side to a red rest post with a red-white bollard beyond. IMG_3131 gives the parts: a white boom with red top and bottom edges at about 1 m in the V fork of a red square rest post (about 1.0 m, 0.08 m, bolted plate, black photocell box towards the pivot, bent from a knock) and the bollard about 0.87 m high. Ends: the boom and the two post shadows in the Google top-down view. Registered from Dave's Google Maps 3D top-down screenshot (reference/google-maps/05-3d-top-down-car-park-north-entrance.jpg, Imagery © Google 2026; taken 25 Nov 2026, capture date not shown): north-up, 0.0385 m per pixel (car lengths 0.040, island-to-wall 0.044), the long wall's north end on its aerial position (-91.4, -67.8); the gatehouse island, narrow planter, brick-and-lawn strip and wall line then sit within about 1-2 m of the Esri aerial. Good to about 1.5 m and 5 degrees. The rest post is 5.5 m from the first estimate from IMG_3131's phone pin (4.7 m): the pin was off, and IMG_3131's camera is moved to match. The boom's direction (81 degrees towards the pivot) agrees with IMG_3131's compass heading (78).

barriers.name: Exit barrier, east lane of the car park's north entrance, between the gatehouse island and the long wall
barriers.trust: Estimated. Street View from Calle Bolivia (Oct 2024, Imagery © Google) shows the east lane closed by a red-and-white boom from a white drive cabinet on the gatehouse island, under a no-entry sign (so this lane is the exit), to the north end of the long wall. Its parts are taken to match the entry barrier; its rest post is not seen close up and no bollard shows beside it. Ends: the boom and the cabinet in the Google top-down view. Registered from Dave's Google Maps 3D top-down screenshot (reference/google-maps/05-3d-top-down-car-park-north-entrance.jpg, Imagery © Google 2026; taken 25 Nov 2026, capture date not shown): north-up, 0.0385 m per pixel (car lengths 0.040, island-to-wall 0.044), the long wall's north end on its aerial position (-91.4, -67.8); the gatehouse island, narrow planter, brick-and-lawn strip and wall line then sit within about 1-2 m of the Esri aerial. Good to about 1.5 m and 5 degrees.

gatehouse.name: Gatehouse on the island between the car park's entry and exit lanes
gatehouse.trust: Estimated. A small white single-storey building with a flat roof and a large grilled window facing the entry lane, in Street View from Calle Loira and Calle Bolivia (Oct 2024, Imagery © Google); it is the Villacana pin in Google Maps and is not in the land registry. Footprint about 3.4 m square from Dave's Google 3D top-down screenshot registered to the aerial (about 1.5 m); height about 2.9 m judged from the window and the people-height signs beside it. Built plain: the window grille, door and signs are left for the detail stage.
